usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no claims at all. Identity anchors give only the most basic facts (name, birth date, CEO/chair roles, degrees). One retained source exists but is unclassified, unattributed, and unattempted for extraction, so nothing substantive can be verified — no career history, achievements, leadership record, or current status. The reader learns only who Mary Barra is in a one-line sense, not what she has done; nothing here could prepare someone for a meeting. The two unjustified conclusions (personal responsibility for the ignition switch recall; personal design of GM vehicles) are flagged but appear nowhere in a dossier, so no overclaim can be matched to a cited dossier statement.
